referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A monochrome one-page template. A full-bleed grayscale mountain photograph fills the opening with a centered light title, a short line, and a teal action. A short intro follows, then alternating image-and-text project rows: a wide image with a caption, then a two-column image/text grid. A dark newsletter band with an email field, three contact cards, and a dark footer close the page. The palette is black, white, and muted gray with a single teal accent.
